Event.description: type is sketch_status, spec, message, handoff or feedback; the remaining fields depend on the type (sketch_id or message_id or handoff_id, status, reason, session_slug, version, feedback_id and kind).
Event.title: Event

Feedback.description: Something the translator tells the user about the sketch, kept apart from the document. spec_version is the version written by the same turn, null when the turn wrote none.
Feedback.title: Feedback

meta.description: JSON: {"client_id": uuid, "conversation": "current"|"new", "conversation_id"?: uuid, "caption"?: string, "pages": [{"page": int, "canvas": {"w", "h", "dpi"}}], "annotates"?: {"spec_version": int >= 1, "pages": [{"page": int, "doc_page": int, "lines": [int, int]}]}}. annotates needs conversation_id and answers 404 no_spec when that spec version does not exist. Part i (sketch.<i>.png, strokes.<i>.json) belongs to pages[i]; every page needs its png.

TaskboardError.description: error body of the taskboard, passed through by the task relay
TaskboardError.title: TaskboardError
